business_model: B2B software and services, pricing not found
product_category: Enterprise AI agents, Salesforce developer tools

technical_complexity.rationale: Pull request review agents on top of foundation models were a common build in 2025; whole codebase context for Salesforce metadata adds some difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Thin application layer on third party models in a space with many AI review tools and incumbent DevOps vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Gearset markets deterministic code review against AI reviewers per its 2026 pages; no copying or acquisition of Sennu found.

market_need_then: Large Salesforce developer and consulting ecosystem with code review needs; the founders grew up around Salesforce consulting per YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found. Search results confuse it with Sennos and SENAI.

outcome_analysis: Sennu AI joined YC in Winter 2025 with two founders from Brex and Confluent and launched Salesforce code review, QA testing and a sales agent. A separate profile says it now helps enterprises deploy Claude, which suggests a broadening of scope. No funding, customer or outcome news was found, so the outcome is open.
